label: Entomen's Tome
description: The mysterious Magi, Entomen, has asked you to retrieve a certain tome from the Merchantry Guild in East Alinea.  Supposedly this will help him to discover the location of a Sapphiron Fragment, an item which he is seeking to acquire.
completedDescription: You helped Entomen by bringing him his tome.

steps.label: Find Entomen's Tome
steps.description: Go to the Merchantry Guild in East Alinea and acquire Entomen's Tome.  It is a titleless book that you supposedly will not be able to open on your own.

steps.label: Join the Merchantry
steps.description: You need to be accepted into the Merchantry to find the tome you seek.  Ask around, maybe somebody will sponsor you?

subSteps.label: Get accepted by the Merchantry
subSteps.description: Surely there's somebody in Alinea who can sponsor you to become a part of the Merchantry.

subSteps.label: Elvyosa's Task
subSteps.description: Elvyosa has asked you to speak to Claire on her behalf.

subSteps.label: Idoreo's Task
subSteps.description: Idoreo has asked you to head north to see if his goods will sell up there.  He has given you fliers to hand out.

subSteps.label: Scopey's Task
subSteps.description: Scopey has asked you to burn down Elvyosa's ship, or at least destroy its cargo.

steps.label: Give Entomen's Tome
steps.description: Bring Entomen's Tome back to him at the Posh Palfrey Inn in West Alinea.

label: Noble Ruffian
description: A fisherman, Igmund, dislikes a certain nobleman who is currently residing in the Crawbell Tavern outside of Alinea.  You've offered to play a 'prank' on the nobleman named Barto Caldeburn by assaulting him with a rock from outside the tavern.
completedDescription: That did not go well... did it?

steps.label: Get a rock
steps.description: Find a rock outside the tavern.

steps.label: Throw the rock
steps.description: Throw the rock at Barto Caldeburn.

subSteps.label: Leave the tavern
subSteps.description: Step outside so you have a clear throw.

label: Omniflower Heist
description: An Omniflower is a particular strain of herb that is used to create very potent healing potions.  Ainsley of the Shrine of Luck in Alinea has tasked you with getting her one.  Trouble is, Omniflowers are extremely carefully regulated by the Realm.  They can be quite hard to come by.
completedDescription: You got an Omniflower for Ainsley and gave it to her.

steps.label: Find an Omniflower
steps.description: If you can't find one in the wilderness, perhaps the Realm has one stored away in one of the Alinea warehouses?

steps.label: Acquire an Omniflower
steps.description: There is an Omniflower inside Alinea Warehouse #2.  Perhaps this is available?

subSteps.label: Find a way inside Warehouse #2
subSteps.description: You need a reliable way inside the warehouse to get the the Omniflower.

subSteps.label: Find the Omniflower
subSteps.description: Now that you're inside, you need to find the Omniflower without getting caught.

subSteps.label: Escape the warehouse
subSteps.description: Find a way out without getting caught.

steps.label: Return to Ainsley
steps.description: Return to Ainsley at the Shrine of Luck in East Alinea

label: Outpost Correspondence
description: Lieutenant Mullen has given you a correspondence to give to an outpost north of Alinea
completedDescription: You have done a small favor for Lieutenant Mullen of the Realm.

steps.label: Deliver the correspondence
steps.description: Deliver Lieutenant Mullen's message to the outpost north of Alinea.

steps.label: Return to Mullen
steps.description: Return to Lieutenant Mullen with the outpost's report.
